facts.source_fact: The February 2026 Farm Practices Survey reports England-level farming-practice statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Do not extrapolate survey percentages to individual parcels or farms.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 Farm Practices Survey results were published on 11 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach release date to survey values.

facts.source_fact: The Farm Practices Survey is usually run annually in February.
facts.expected_handling: Use survey year as the comparison key.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 results are based on questions sent to approximately 7,000 holdings in England.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve survey-design context with percentages.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 54% of farms considered greenhouse-gas emissions fairly or very important in farm decisions.
facts.expected_handling: Treat this as a survey response proportion, not an emissions measurement.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 11% of farms rated greenhouse-gas emissions as very important in decision-making.
facts.expected_handling: Keep response-category wording with the percentage.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 43% of farms rated greenhouse-gas emissions as fairly important.
facts.expected_handling: Keep response-category wording with the percentage.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 31% rated greenhouse-gas emissions as not very important.
facts.expected_handling: Keep response-category wording with the percentage.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 10% rated greenhouse-gas emissions as not at all important.
facts.expected_handling: Keep response-category wording with the percentage.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 4% selected the response that their farm does not produce greenhouse gases.
facts.expected_handling: Treat this as respondent belief, not verified zero emissions.

facts.source_fact: Around 37% of farms believed reducing farm greenhouse-gas emissions would contribute to overall profitability.
facts.expected_handling: Treat this as reported belief rather than demonstrated financial effect.

facts.source_fact: In 2026, 47% of farms were actively implementing measures to lower greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer the emissions reduction magnitude from participation alone.

facts.source_fact: Among farms taking action, recycling waste materials was reported by about 75% in the published action breakdown.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the denominator as farms taking action.

facts.source_fact: Improving energy efficiency was reported by about 69% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert practice adoption directly into CO2e savings.

facts.source_fact: Reduced tillage was reported by about 68% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Keep practice adoption separate from measured mitigation.

facts.source_fact: Improving accuracy of nitrogen fertiliser application was reported by about 59% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer a specific emissions reduction without farm-level data.

facts.source_fact: Including clover in grassland was reported by about 52% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Treat as practice prevalence only.

facts.source_fact: Changes to manure or slurry management were reported by about 45% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Treat as practice prevalence only.

facts.source_fact: Methane-suppressing feed products were reported by about 2% of farms taking action.
facts.expected_handling: Keep low adoption prevalence distinct from efficacy.

facts.source_fact: The published FPS dataset provides a time series from 2011 to 2026 where comparable questions exist.
facts.expected_handling: Check question comparability before interpreting trends.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve survey wording, denominator and percentage.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents converting survey responses into measurements.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach England survey population, holding and respondent/practice boundary.
Attach survey year, release date and question comparability.
Carry survey methodology, sample context and published table provenance.
Do not convert England survey practice rates into parcel-level measured emissions.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
